audit.whatIsWrong: Page is rated TRICKY 7/10 and the level chart hands Karma Level 1 and 2+ items, contradicting the 54.1% win rate, the packet levelChart (Skill / Urgot x6) and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The Karma-side audit set this lane to HARD 8/10 for Karma with Urgot winning every stage from Level 2. Inverse of that is a favoured 3/10 lane for Urgot.
audit.corrected: diff EASY, diffRating 3/10, chart flipped to Skill / Urgot x6 in matched full+content pairs, ratings raised to match.

audit.why: Spikes are keyed correctly: Purge ranks at 3-5, the Fear Beyond Death execute at 6, Black Cleaver first item, and Karma having no ultimate spike because Mantra only empowers a spell.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spike windows; only the fabricated cleanse claim inside spikes[0] was replaced.
sources: enemyKit R text: 'Karma empowers her next ability'

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields claim Purge (W) 'cleanses' Focused Resolve and 'removes the tether before the snare lands'. Purge is a channelled attack with a self-slow — it has no cleanse component anywhere in Riot's text and no cleanse flag in the kit.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a 675-range tether that only roots if the tether is NOT broken. It is broken by leaving range or line of sight, not by an Urgot ability. Telling a player to press W and ignore the tether gets them rooted every time.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real interaction: the 675 tether breaks on range or line of sight — step behind minions or out of it, then Q slow and Disdain (E, 475 range, 16s at rank 1) walk her down. Also added the Grievous Wounds line for Mantra-W's heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank, so the punish window is fixed and easy to count.
audit.corrected: Kept the 'trade on the cooldown' framing and made the tether-break mechanic concrete so the window is usable.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].t says 'Eat his Focused Resolve for free' — wrong pronoun for Karma.
audit.why: Gender slip inherited from a template.

edits.before: At level 2 Urgot's Purge cleanses the Focused Resolve root and flips the trade.
edits.after: At level 2 Purge out-damages her Inner Flame poke, so she loses the trade.

edits.before: Karma's mantra'd Inner Flame (Q) poke and Focused Resolve (W) root are her only tools, and both are single-target and telegraphed. Once you hit level 2-3, cleanse her W root with Purge (W) — it removes the tether before the snare lands — then Q slow and Disdain (E) walk her down. She has no dash and no hard CC beyond that root.
edits.after: Karma's mantra'd Inner Flame (Q) poke and Focused Resolve (W) root are her only tools, and both are single-target and telegraphed. Focused Resolve tethers at 675 and breaks on range or line of sight — step behind minions or out of it and the snare never lands, then Q slow and Disdain (E) walk her down. She has no dash beyond that root.

edits.before: From level 2 onward you own the lane: Purge (W) cleanses her root before it snares, then Q slow and E let you walk her down, and level 6 gives you a clean R execute since her ult is just a spell-empower with no defensive value.
edits.after: From level 2 onward you own the lane: break her 675-range tether on line of sight before it snares, then Q slow and E walk her down, and level 6 gives a clean R execute since Mantra is just a spell-empower with no defensive value.

edits.before: Purge (W) her Focused Resolve root before the snare completes
edits.after: Break her Focused Resolve tether on range or LoS before it snares

edits.before: Trade strictly around Focused Resolve: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.
edits.after: Trade around Focused Resolve's flat 12s: when it is down, run the full pattern. Her Mantra-W heals her through chip, so buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Focused Resolve and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 3/10. The lane is decided by how well you break the Focused Resolve tether and how disciplined you are.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Karma carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 3/10, Urgot carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: Eat his Focused Resolve for free
edits.after: Eat her Focused Resolve for free
